description: Max 50 entries per bulk call—split large catalogs into batches of ~50 to avoid oversized tool payloads. For full re-import: delete-entries once, then set-entries in 50-entry chunks; or replace-entries with deleteOrphans=false until the final batch (deleteOrphans=true). Idempotent sync for up to 50 entries in scope; optionally delete orphans not in this batch. Match by upsertBy (default kind+title). For large catalogs use deleteOrphans=false on intermediate batches, true only on the last batch.

deleteOrphans.description: Delete scope entries missing from this batch (default true; set false until final batch)

entries.description: Batch slice for this scope (max 50; repeat calls for larger catalogs)

entryIds.description: Related entry ids, e.g. flow steps pointing to other entries

files.description: Workspace-relative file paths where this fact lives

moduleName.description: Module name from list-modules; per-entry override of batch moduleName
Default refs.moduleName for entries without refs.moduleName

projectId.description: Required. Call list-projects first (query by workspace folder name) and pass the matching projectId. Never omit. default-project is forbidden.

scope.description: Which existing entries participate in orphan deletion

moduleName.description: Only entries linked to this module

tags.description: Entries having any of these tags

upsertBy.description: Fields used to match existing entries (default kind+title)

name: replace-entries
title: Replace Entries
